widgets.label: Select Sequence
widgets.onCreate: window.updateSeqButtonStyle = function(buttonId, seqValue) { var style = ''; if (seqValue === 'custom') { style = 'background-color: rgba(44, 53, 69, 1.00);'; } else if (seqValue && seqValue !== 'hold' && seqValue !== 'unit' && seqValue !== '') { style = 'background-color: rgba(44, 53, 69, 1.00); border: 1px solid rgba(120, 130, 150, 0.6);'; } setVar(buttonId, 'seqStyle', style); }; window.openSeqModal = function(param, instance, stateId, type) { type = type || 'plaits'; var seq = get(stateId); console.log('openSeqModal called:', param, instance, stateId, type, 'seq:', seq); set('seqModal/context', {param: param, instance: instance, stateId: stateId, type: type}); window._initializingSeqModal = true; set('seqModal/switch', seq); window._initializingSeqModal = false; console.log('Opening modal'); set('seqModal', 1); };

widgets.css: inner { grid-auto-flow: column !important; grid-template-rows: repeat(20, auto) !important; grid-template-columns: repeat(10, 1fr) !important; }
widgets.onValue: if (window._initializingSeqModal) return; if (value === '' || value === null || value === undefined) return; var ctx = get('seqModal/context'); if (!ctx || !ctx.param || !ctx.instance || !ctx.stateId) return; var previousValue = get(ctx.stateId); var addr = '/' + (ctx.type || 'plaits') + '/' + ctx.instance + '/' + ctx.param + '/seq'; if (typeof value === 'string' && value === previousValue) { send(addr, 'hold'); set(ctx.stateId, 'hold'); set('seqModal/switch', ''); } else if (typeof value === 'string' && value.length > 0) { send(addr, value); set(ctx.stateId, value); }

widgets.onKeyboard: if (code === 'Digit1') { var current = get('plaits/1/mute'); send('/plaits/1/mute', current ? 0 : 1); set('plaits/1/mute', current ? 0 : 1); } else if (code === 'Digit2') { var current = get('plaits/2/mute'); send('/plaits/2/mute', current ? 0 : 1); set('plaits/2/mute', current ? 0 : 1); } else if (code === 'Digit3') { var current = get('plaits/3/mute'); send('/plaits/3/mute', current ? 0 : 1); set('plaits/3/mute', current ? 0 : 1); } else if (code === 'Digit4') { var current = get('samples/1/mute'); send('/samples/1/mute', current ? 0 : 1); set('samples/1/mute', current ? 0 : 1); } else if (code === 'Digit5') { var current = get('samples/2/mute'); send('/samples/2/mute', current ? 0 : 1); set('samples/2/mute', current ? 0 : 1); } else if (code === 'Digit6') { var current = get('samples/3/mute'); send('/samples/3/mute', current ? 0 : 1); set('samples/3/mute', current ? 0 : 1); } else if (code === 'ArrowLeft') { send('/dreads/prevPatch', 1); } else if (code === 'ArrowRight') { send('/dreads/nextPatch', 1); } else if (code === 'Tab') { var current = get('container'); set('container', (current + 1) % 3); }
if (type === 'keydown') { var current = get('dreads/start'); set('dreads/start', current ? 0 : 1); }
